summary: One-frame event added by the client projectile when it explodes (caller bg3.exe+0x1894B90 ~ ecl::Projectile::TryExplode). Holds the spell-cast target the projectile hit: exactly Script Extender's spell_cast::IntermediateTarget (0xA8 bytes), declared here as own structs. Born live while casting projectile spells (Eldritch Blast, Scorching Ray) together with ecl::Projectile and ecl::projectile::SpellComponent.
